word: and one long record now has a memory that is both high and rising
reasons: We are working past the edge of our own calibration: the forecast models stands at 3.28 today against 2.59, which is all it was fitted on; Niño 3, weekly stands at 3.7 today against 3.3, which is all it was fitted on
Memory both high and rising: Niño 3.4, weekly since 1981 (τ 0.357, 85.6th percentile of its own history)
Rising but not high, so it does not count as a sign: Niño 3.4, monthly since 1948 (τ 0.243, 64.9th percentile)
The air leans one way for every instrument, but no further than 1.02 prediction errors, which is still inside the relation

The restoring force cannot be judged yet, and the collector refuses to judge it: 6 of 8 conditions are met, and these are not: phase_deep_enough, enough_comparable_events. The fuel stands at the 99.89th percentile of 1746 weeks and over 9 weeks of this event it has not fallen but risen by 13 mm

link.scope: два экваториальных бокса, 0,4% поверхности планеты; ни один из оценённых элементов климатической системы не проявится здесь первым — это слежение за тропической Пацификой
link.reading: The response of the air is ordinary for this sea temperature while every variant stays inside two prediction errors; a break shows first as all of them leaving on the same side.

coupling.note: El Niño is a coupling of ocean and air, not a warm patch of water. These three say whether the air is answering: pressure across the Pacific, the cloud tower over the date line, and the trade winds. When they stop answering, the teleconnections that carry the event to harvests stop with them.

fuel.note: Warm water volume is the fuel gauge: the heat piled up in the upper 300 m of the equatorial Pacific before it reaches the surface. It leads the surface index, so it answers the one question the models only guess at — whether the event still has something to grow on. The lead is measured on our own data, not assumed.

out_of_range.fitted_note: every error in their record was measured below the highest ONI since 1950, 2.59 °C (NDJ 2015)
out_of_range.today_note: their own combined forecast for DJF 2027 is 3.28 °C

out_of_range.fitted_note: the highest weekly value before this event began, 3.3 °C (1997-11-12)

recharge.verdict: вывод пока не осмыслен, не пройдены условия: phase_deep_enough, enough_comparable_events

failed.text: нынешняя фаза не раньше той, на которой прошлые события уже разряжались: иначе «разрядка не идёт» значит «ещё рано».
есть хотя бы три сравнимых прошлых ПОДТВЕРЖДЁННЫХ события (пик засчитывается, только если он пройден: справа от него есть окно).

recharge.kind: ЗАМЕНИТЕЛЬ. Аномалия уровня моря (NASA-SSH reference, сетка 0,5°, продукт NASA_SSH_REF_SIMPLE_GRID_V11, PO.DAAC/JPL) — расчёт по чужому алгоритму на прямом измерении времени пробега радиоимпульса: из него вычтены орбита, средняя поверхность DTU21, приливы, обратный барометр и атмосферные задержки, затем вдольтрековые точки интерполированы в сетку (pyresample resample_gauss). Это НЕ наш замер и НЕ измеренный объём воды выше изотермы 20 °C, а его общепринятый спутниковый заменитель.

provenance.why: версия обработки и журнал её изменений; сутки, где версий больше одной, содержат среднее по версиям, и скачок показателя, совпавший с датой из журнала, обязан быть проверен на происхождение прежде толкования как атмосфера

what_this_is: A watch for a change of regime, which is a different question from how strong the event is. A record is a position on the curve; a change of regime is the curve itself giving way. Nothing on this page is a level of anything — these are relations, the memory of the series, and the restoring force.
how_the_level_is_set: By a written rule, not by a formula: nobody has measured the weights of these five signs against each other, so adding them into one number would be an invention. The rule is printed beside the level, each sign carries its own figure, and a reader who disagrees with the verdict can still keep the data.
what_it_cannot_see: Two equatorial boxes are 0.4 % of the planet. None of the assessed tipping elements — the Greenland ice, the Atlantic overturning, the Amazon, the permafrost — would show here first. This is a watch on the tropical Pacific and on the three long records of the index itself, and it is not a watch on the climate system.
false_alarms: Rising memory in a series has honest causes that are not a transition: a change of instrument, a long warm spell, the smoothing we applied ourselves. The windows overlap, so a trend across them looks more significant than it is; the count of independent windows is printed beside each record for that reason.
